{{recipe}}

This recipe for '''ice pops''' uses a blend of fresh fruits.
==Ingredients==
*[[Cookbook:Mango|Mango]], peeled and [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
*[[Cookbook:Peach|Peach]], peeled and diced
*[[Cookbook:Strawberry|Strawberries]]
*[[Cookbook:Watermelon|Watermelon]], diced
*[[Cookbook:Pear|Pear]], juiced
==Procedure==
#Combine all fruits with pear juice in a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]]. [[Cookbook:Puréeing|Purée]] until smooth.
#Divide the fruit mixture between ice pop molds, and insert the sticks.
#Freeze the molds until completely solid.
#Unmold the ice pops, and serve immediately
==Notes, tips, and variations==
*The fruits used should be ripe.
